biomarkers.name: EWSR1-FLI1 fusion (t(11;22))
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defining feature; FLI1 IHC and EWSR1 break-apart FISH as surrogates

biomarkers.name: Other EWSR1 fusion partners (ETV1, ETV4, FEV)
CD99 (MIC2)
biomarkers.prevalence: Diffuse strong membranous positive in most cases
biomarkers.clinical_use: Classical diagnostic marker (not specific — also positive in lymphoblastic lymphoma, DSRCT, others)

biomarkers.name: STAG2 loss
biomarkers.clinical_use: Associated with adverse prognosis in some series

biomarkers.name: CIC-DUX4, BCOR-CCNB3 (Ewing-like / undifferentiated round cell sarcomas)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Distinct entities in WHO 2020 — NOT Ewing sarcoma; distinct behaviour

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Small round blue cell tumour with sheets of uniform primitive cells, Homer-Wright rosettes in a subset

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Immune-cold — low TMB, sparse TILs; IO responses generally poor
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Sheets of small round blue cells with delicate vasculature; extensive necrosis

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Uncertain — neural crest-derived mesenchymal stem cells proposed; some evidence for endothelial or mesenchymal progenitor origin
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm — primitive mesenchymal (may have neural crest contribution)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Undifferentiated small round blue cell tumour with focal neural (Homer-Wright rosettes in subset) or epithelial differentiation possible; CD99+ (MIC2) diffuse membranous pattern is characteristic
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: EWSR1-FLI1 (~85%) or EWSR1-ERG (~5-10%) fusion is defining — creates chimeric transcription factor that reprograms mesenchymal precursors and disrupts normal lineage specification; the fusion binds GGAA microsatellites throughout genome producing aberrant enhancer activity
